title: Customer onboarding case and progression state machine
workflow: Start institution-scoped case with selected product intent and privacy notice
Collect minimum party data plus requested services without activating an account
Validate documents, duplicate signals, mandates and identity declarations
Route incomplete, suspicious or mismatched cases to review with reasons
Obtain compliance and maker-checker approvals for applicable risk class
Create accepted customer relationship only after all mandatory case checks pass
invariants: A case approval must not itself post money or activate credit/payment services
Applicant cannot change submitted evidence without versioning and reviewer notification
All case status transitions must be explicitly authorized and logged
Never auto-approve cases with unresolved sanctions, identity mismatch or unauthorized representative
Return machine-readable reasons for missing documents without leaking sensitive screening results
Allow resumption after offline/network failure without duplicate cases via idempotency
acceptance_tests: Attempted approval with missing KYC requirements rejected
Reviewer approves own submitted case denied where maker-checker required
Case created in one institution cannot be read in another
Withdrawn case cannot be used to open an account
gate: Onboarding channel policy, institution mandatory evidence matrix, identity/risk requirements and independent reviewer workflow.
